text:
sara: heads up — CSV export from scorecard drilldown on stage is producing duplicated sample_ids when run-level stitching is enabled. repro: stage /scorecard/123 -> Export -> CSV. Can someone look? :grimacing:

ben: do you have a minimal repro and a link to the run id? I'll try to reproduce locally.

sara: run id 2024-09-29-zzq, exported file attached (see gist). quick repro SQL I used in the export service:
```
SELECT s.sample_id, r.run_id
FROM samples s
JOIN sample_stitch ss ON ss.child_id = s.sample_id
WHERE r.run_id = '2024-09-29-zzq'
ORDER BY s.sample_index;
```
This returns repeated sample_id rows for stitched segments.

ivy: hmm I remember removing DISTINCT in PR #748 because it flattened order -> PR: https://github.com/redwood/scorecard/pull/748

deploy-bot: Deployed scorecard-api 1.12.4 to stage at 2024-09-29T15:03:21Z

maya: quantized runs use stitcher to merge segments, duplicates are expected downstream unless you dedupe by sample_id before export. quick fix: in export handler wrap ids in an ordered_set before writing CSV.

cheng: prefer fixing in SQL to avoid memory hits. something like:
```
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT s.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.sample_id ORDER BY s.sample_index) rn
  FROM samples s JOIN sample_stitch ss ON ss.child_id = s.sample_id...
) t WHERE rn = 1;
```
Keeps order and dedupes.

ivy: ok I'll draft the SQL change as a toggle behind a feature flag so we can roll back if perf changes. I'll open a PR.

sara: thanks. filing ticket: TKT-4521 (scorecard/export duplicated sample_ids) — tagging @maya @cheng

qa-bot: Created TKT-4521 and added to 'regressions' board. Steps to verify added.

ben: repro'd locally with the run id, duplicates gone with the window-function fix. no perf regression on stage dataset (~10k rows).

ivy: PR #759 opened: https://github.com/redwood/scorecard/pull/759 — includes toggle and tests. requesting review from @cheng @maya

maya: LGTM, a couple comments on test edge-cases.

cheng: will review this afternoon. if green, we can merge and deploy to stage tonight :thumbsup:

sara: awesome, thanks team :party-parrot:
